name: Gaussian Transfer Function for Density Isosurfaces
definition: A transfer function T(n) that maps density n to color and opacity using a Gaussian in log10 space, designed to highlight specific density isosurfaces while suppressing others.
summary: The Gaussian Transfer Function for Density Isosurfaces maps volumetric density to color and opacity using a Gaussian in logarithmic space, maintaining constant width in log-space to effectively visualize power-law distributions like astrophysical gas.
